title: d2-v1 Note 删除入口（目录行 + 编辑器工具栏 + 二次确认/失败重试）— fork Before/After visual evidence
synthetic_declaration: Real fork Next.js app (next dev --webpack, embedded iframe) + synthetic host page + route-mocked Research Gateway. No real RDLens host, PostgreSQL, SurrealDB, files, models, Feishu content, users or private data. All note titles/ids/content are [synthetic] fixtures (project p1, viewer 1, fabricated claims-only token).
head: f3e4e47a3aa68ec0ee97370c9b5341929bb0fb46

before_na_scenes.e2: N/A — baseline has no d2-v1 delete entry, so the delete confirmation dialog does not exist; no baseline screenshot was fabricated
before_na_scenes.e3: N/A — baseline cannot delete a d2-v1 note from the UI (no delete entry, no DELETE mutation path)
before_na_scenes.e4: N/A — baseline has no editor-toolbar delete entry, so the editor delete success flow does not exist
before_na_scenes.e5: N/A — baseline has no d2-v1 delete entry, so a 403 restricted delete error state does not exist
before_na_scenes.e6: N/A — baseline has no d2-v1 delete entry, so no 409 revision-conflict / refresh-and-review flow exists
before_na_scenes.e7: N/A — baseline has no d2-v1 delete entry, so no unknown-result / same-mutation replay flow exists
before_na_scenes.e8: N/A — baseline has no d2-v1 delete entry, so no 503 dependency-unavailable retry flow exists
before_na_scenes.e12: N/A — E12 is merged into E2 (impact/reference copy inside the delete dialog); baseline has no dialog

env.harness_only_config_patch: frontend/src/lib/embedded/config.ts static NEXT_PUBLIC_* member access (Next dev does not inline dynamic env lookups); reverted after capture
env.layout_probe: real Chromium boundingBox/scroll geometry of the d2-v1 row title, compact delete icon, Insert excerpt entry and legacy old Delete action (E1, both widths); no CSS-string parsing

contract_copy.unsavedLocal: Unsaved changes in the open editor will be discarded.

env.scene_notes: E2 also carries the E12 assertions (impact/reference copy inside the delete dialog). E3/E4 seed two sessionStorage draft-cache tab branches in the app frame and assert all branches for the deleted note are removed.
